note: The labelled set is split once, here. `train` feeds the judge's example bank (packages/domain/src/follow-up-examples.json: every example names its case in `id`); every other case is held out, and is what run.mjs scores by default. A bank example is never a held-out case: tests/followUpJudge.test.mjs holds the two apart, by id, by message and by near-duplicate.
